name: Nitin Spinners Limited
summary: Nitin Spinners Limited manufactures and sells cotton and blended yarns, knitted fabrics, and finished woven fabrics in India and internationally. The company offers yarn products comprising cotton and poly/cotton blended, ring spun combed and carded, open end, compact, slub, core spun, multifold, twist, gassed, contamination free, and dye-able cheese/cones yarns, as well as yarn products made from Supima Giza, Organic, BCI cotton, and recycled fibres; and yarns with count range 6 to 100s. Its yarn products are used in woven and knitted apparel, tea bags, furnishing and medical fabrics, denims, and terry tow applications.
